title: ADR-0015 — Use hap.py's xcmp engine, not vcfeval
summary: Switches hap.py benchmarking from the vcfeval engine to the self-contained xcmp engine because the pinned container lacks rtg-tools.
notes: Partial supersession: overrides only the comparison-engine choice in ADR-0003 (vcfeval -> xcmp); ADR-0003's benchmarking stage, F1 >= 0.99 acceptance criterion, and rejected alternatives remain in force.
